snippet.title: Skin Witch Launch Trailer (Gameplay)
snippet.description:
Skin Witch is now live on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164990/Skin_Witch/

Skin Witch is a traditional-style survival horror game that lets you defend yourself, while managing limited ammo and resources.
